description: Use this when you need the title/abstract screening decisions: per record the decision, whether a human or the AI made it, and per criterion the verdict and the reason quoting the abstract, with a flag saying whether the quote was found verbatim. action results (decision filters by the web's buckets: include, exclude, revisar; 10 per page, up to 100 with limit, then next_cursor; counts and total come from the same figures as the web; detail concise shows the key criterion with a short quote, detail full every criterion), action conflicts (records left in 'review' or in disagreement), or action agreement (Cohen's kappa, observed agreement, the 2x2 table and n between the researcher and the invited second reviewer, only after both reviews meet; before that it says what is missing). Pages are read in record-id order and work on reviews of any size: on very large reviews a call may return fewer rows with partial true; call again with next_cursor. Those, and records hit by a criteria change, are decided by the researcher in revisia: give them human_review's link and message. Never judge or decide them yourself, nor offer to. Read-only; respects blind dual screening.

decision.description: results: only this bucket, the web's filter (include = Included, exclude = Excluded, revisar = To review).

detail.description: concise: decision + key criterion, quote cut; full: every criterion with its quote.
